Limited, was ascertained to be Rs. 68,500,000/-, hence it was concluded that no impairment was required as at 31 March 2026.

38.1 Parent and ultimate controlling party
Carson Cumberbatch PLC is the Parent Company of Ceylon Beverage Holdings PLC and Bukit Darah PLC is the Ultimate Parent and
Controlling Entity of Ceylon Beverage Holdings PLC.
38.2 Transactions with Key Management Personnel (KMP)
(I) According to Sri Lanka Accounting Standard 24 “Related Party Disclosures”, key management personnel are those having authority
and responsibility for planning and controlling the activities of the entity. Accordingly, the Directors of the Company and its parent
company (including Executive, Non-Executive Directors and Chief Financial Officer) have been classified as KMP of the Company.
